name: Hallward
title: The Charter's Buyer
examine: Amberford tailoring, Amberford manners, and a standing offer the moot declines every quarter with tremendous courtesy. He has been here a year. He counts it in winters now.
lines: The Charter offers stability. The moot offers me tea.
Finest leather in the Dawnlands and no contract on any of it. It keeps me up at night.
I have started to like the cold. Do not tell Amberford.
